questions.stem: Which of the following is a life process essential for the survival of living beings?
questions.solution: Nutrition is a life process essential for survival because it involves taking in and using food for energy and growth. Sleeping, playing, and dancing are not essential life processes as they do not directly support the basic functions needed for survival.

questions.stem: What is the process called when grass-eating animals like cows partially chew food, swallow it, and then regurgitate it for further chewing?
questions.solution: The process described is called rumination, where animals like cows regurgitate and re-chew their food. Swallowing is just the act of taking food into the stomach. Digestion refers to the breakdown of food in the stomach. Regeneration is the ability to regrow lost body parts, which is not mentioned here.

hi.stem: घास खाने वाले जानवरों जैसे गायों में आंशिक रूप से भोजन कुचलने, उसे निगलने और फिर से कुचलने के लिए फिर से उलटने की प्रक्रिया क्या कहलाती है?
hi.solution: वर्णित प्रक्रिया को अग्निमंथन कहते हैं, जिसमें गाय जैसे जानवर भोजन को उलटते हैं और फिर से कुचलते हैं। निगलना केवल भोजन के पेट में ले जाने की क्रिया है। पाचन भोजन के पेट में टूटने के अर्थ में आता है। पुनर्जनन नष्ट हुए शरीर के हिस्सों को फिर से बढ़ाने की क्षमता है, जो यहां उल्लेख नहीं किया गया है।
hi.critique: The Hindi translation accurately reflects the English question and solution, with appropriate terminology used in a Hindi-medium biology context.

questions.stem: Which part of the digestive system is responsible for partially digesting proteins?
questions.solution: The stomach contains acids and enzymes that begin the breakdown of proteins. The small intestine, liver, and pancreas are involved in other stages of digestion but do not primarily digest proteins. The stomach is the correct answer because it is the primary site where protein digestion starts.

mr.solution: आतड्यात अम्ल आणि एन्झाइम असतात जे प्रोटीनच्या बायोडेग्रेशनला सुरुवात करतात. लहान आतडे, यकृत आणि अग्न्याशय हे पाचनाच्या इतर टप्प्यांमध्ये सहभागी असतात परंतु प्रोटीनचे पाचन प्राथमिकपणे करत नाहीत. आतडे हे प्रोटीनच्या पाचनाच्या सुरुवातीचे मुख्य स्थान असल्यामुळे ते योग्य उत्तर आहे.

questions.stem: What is the function of mucus in the stomach?
questions.solution: Mucus in the stomach forms a protective layer that prevents the acidic environment from damaging the stomach lining. While digestive enzymes break down proteins and the small intestine absorbs nutrients, mucus specifically serves a protective role. The acid is neutralized by other mechanisms, not by mucus.

questions.stem: What happens to starchy food like chapati when it is chewed for a long time in the mouth?
questions.solution: When starchy food like chapati is chewed for a long time, it becomes sweet because the enzyme in saliva breaks down starch into simpler sugars. This chemical change alters the taste, making it sweet. The other options do not accurately describe the chemical reaction that occurs during chewing.

questions.stem: What is the main difference between breathing and respiration?
choices: Breathing is a physical process, respiration is chemical
Breathing brings in oxygen, respiration uses oxygen
Breathing involves the lungs, respiration involves the heart
Breathing is external, respiration is internal
questions.solution: Breathing is a physical process where air is inhaled and exhaled, while respiration is a chemical process that occurs inside the body where oxygen is used to break down food and release energy. The other options are partially true but do not capture the fundamental difference between the two processes.

questions.stem: Which of the following best describes the process of respiration in the body?
choices: It is the process of taking in oxygen and releasing carbon dioxide
It is the process of breaking down food to release energy
It is the process of transporting oxygen through the circulatory system
It is the process of exchanging gases in the alveoli
questions.solution: Respiration is the process of breaking down food to release energy, which occurs at the cellular level. While taking in oxygen and releasing carbon dioxide is part of the process, it is more accurately described as breathing. Transporting oxygen and gas exchange in the alveoli are parts of the respiratory system but not the full definition of respiration. The core of respiration is the chemical reaction that releases energy from food.

questions.stem: If a person has celiac disease, what is the most likely effect on their small intestine?
choices: It is damaged and cannot absorb properly
questions.solution: Celiac disease causes the immune system to attack the lining of the small intestine when gluten is consumed, leading to damage that impairs nutrient absorption. The other options are incorrect because the small intestine does not become longer, absorb more nutrients, or produce more mucus as a result of the condition.

questions.stem: Which of the following best explains why birds have a gizzard in their digestive system?
questions.solution: Birds have a gizzard that helps grind food, often with the help of swallowed grit. Birds do not have teeth, so the gizzard functions as a mechanical digestive organ. Storing food is the role of the stomach, and enzymes are produced by the pancreas and other organs.

hi.stem: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा विवरण पक्षियों के पाचन तंत्र में एक गज़िया (gizzard) होने के कारण के लिए सबसे अच्छा स्पष्टीकरण प्रस्तुत करता है?
hi.solution: पक्षी गज़िया के साथ खाद्य को चूर्ण करते हैं, जिसके साथ अक्सर गिरीट (कच्चा बजरा) के साथ मदद मिलती है। पक्षियों के दांत नहीं होते, इसलिए गज़िया एक यांत्रिक पाचन अंग के रूप में कार्य करता है। खाद्य को संग्रहित करना पेट का कार्य होता है, और एंजाइम पैंक्रियास और अन्य अंगों द्वारा उत्पादित किए जाते हैं।
hi.critique: The Hindi translation accurately reflects the English content with appropriate biological terminology.

questions.stem: Why is the process of respiration considered a chemical process?
choices: Because it involves the movement of air in and out of the lungs
Because it requires energy to break down food
Because it involves the breakdown of glucose to release energy
Because it takes place in the alveoli of the lungs
questions.solution: Respiration is considered a chemical process because it involves the breakdown of glucose in the presence of oxygen to release energy, which is a chemical reaction. The other options describe physical movements, energy requirements, or locations, but do not explain the chemical changes that define the process.
